conflicts: The product FAQ still describes reward points as evergreen. The MITC states that WOW! points lapse 24 months after they are credited.
The product page shows both 4 reward points per ₹150 and 4 reward points per ₹200. Treat earn as up to 4X until the live table is confirmed.
The wow-pdp FAQ and the MITC disagree on the cash advance fee.
disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails.

fuel_surcharge.summary: A 1% fuel surcharge waiver applies on transactions from ₹200 to ₹5,000.

conditions.summary: The waiver is capped at ₹100 per statement cycle.

base_earn.summary: The product page advertises up to 4X earn, including 4X on travel. Insurance, utility, FASTag, and railway spends earn 1X. Fuel, EMI, and cash advances earn no reward points.
base_earn.notes: The same page also shows 4 reward points per ₹150 and 4 reward points per ₹200.

accelerated.summary: Travel, online, offline, and international spends are marketed at 4X. App bonuses of 50 reward points on hotels and 30 reward points on flights are described; the monthly cap for vanilla WOW! is not restated on the base product page.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: One reward point equals ₹0.50 on travel through the IDFC FIRST Rewards Gallery. Pay with points is available in store and online. The MITC lists a ₹99 redemption fee.

expiry.summary: The MITC states that reward points expire 24 months after they are credited. For the June 2026 cycle that means validity through June 2028.
expiry.notes: The product FAQ still describes points as evergreen. The MITC takes precedence.

summary.summary: Domestic lounge access is provided through the issuer lounge programme, not Priority Pass. Access depends on meeting spend requirements in the calendar month of the visit.

domestic.summary: The card includes one complimentary domestic lounge visit per quarter.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹20,000 in the current calendar month.

accident.summary: Forex-cards listing copy for WOW! cites personal accident cover of ₹2 lakh. Confirm against the WOW! product T&C before relying on this figure.

card_protect.summary: Forex-cards listing copy for WOW! cites card liability cover of ₹25,000 and purchase protection of ₹25,000. Confirm against the WOW! product T&C before relying on these figures.

milestones.summary: Lounge access is gated on ₹20,000 spend in the current calendar month. The card is FD-backed, with eligibility minima that differ by customer type on the product FAQ.
